---
title: "Interactive Dashboard"
format: html
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| label: Install and Load Libraries
#| echo: false
#| message: true
#| warning: true

if(!require("shiny"))
  install.packages("shiny")
  library(shiny)

if(!require("DT"))
  install.packages("DT")
  library(DT)

if(!require("DBI"))
  install.packages("DBI")
  library(DBI)

if(!require("RSQLite"))
  install.packages("RSQLite")
  library(RSQLite)

if(!require("ggplot2"))
  install.packages("ggplot2")
  library(ggplot2)

if(!require("plotly"))
  install.packages("plotly")
  library(plotly)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("dplyr")
  library(dplyr)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("bslib")
  library(bslib)

conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "virtual_production.db")
dbListTables(conn)
crew_list <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM CrewMembers")

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(
    version = 5,
    bootswatch = "flatly", 
    base_font = font_google("Roboto"), 
    heading_font = "Montserrat", 
    primary="#007bff"),
  titlePanel("Virtual Production Dashboard"),
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Data View",
      h3("Explore Database Tables"),
      selectInput(
          "table_select", 
          "Select a Table to View:",
          choices = c("Clients", "Productions", "CrewMembers", "Assets"),
          selected = "Clients"),
      DTOutput("table_output"))),
      tabsetPanel(tabPanel("Plot View", 
      selectInput(
        "crew_select", 
        "Select Crew Member:",
        choices = crew_list$Name),
      dateRangeInput(
        "date_range",
        "Completion Date Range:",
        start="2023-01-01", end = Sys.Date()),
      plotlyOutput("crew_plot"),
      hr())))

server <- function(input, output, session){
  
  output$table_output <- renderDT({
    req(input$table_select)
    df <- dbReadTable(conn, input$table_select)
    datatable(df, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
  


output$crew_plot <- renderPlotly({
  req(input$crew_select, input$date_range)
  query <- sprintf(
    "SELECT Productions.Title, Productions.EndDate, Productions.Budget FROM ProductionCrew.ProductionID JOIN CrewMembers Crew ON ProductionCrew.CrewID = Crew.CrewID Where Crew.Name = '%s' AND DATE(Productions.EndDate) BETWEEN '%s' AND '%s' ", input$crew_select, input$date_range[1], input$date_range[2])
  df <-dbGetQuery(conn, query)
  ggplotly(
    ggplot(df, aes(x = EndDate, y = Budget, text = Title)) +
      geom_point(color = "#007bff", size = 3) + 
      labs(title = paste("Productions for", input$crew_select), 
           x = "Completion Date", y = "Budget") +
      theme_minimal()
  )
})
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

renv::status(
  
)
```
